{
  "dataset_name": "led7",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "active_segment_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Total number of lit LED segments across all seven attributes, a continuous severity-like sum useful for linear margins.",
      "value_range": [0, 7],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_sum",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth ordinal projection separating digits with few vs many lit segments.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#1 + attribute#2 + attribute#3 + attribute#4 + attribute#5 + attribute#6 + attribute#7"
    },
    {
      "name": "active_segment_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of segments that are lit, normalized to [0,1] for stable SVM scaling.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized magnitude feature that linearly correlates with overall pattern density.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#1 + attribute#2 + attribute#3 + attribute#4 + attribute#5 + attribute#6 + attribute#7) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "top_bottom_symmetry",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between top-region segments (1,2,3) and bottom-region segments (5,6,7), a symmetry severity score.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "symmetry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures vertical asymmetry that linearly differentiates digit shapes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs((attribute#1 + attribute#2 + attribute#3) - (attribute#5 + attribute#6 + attribute#7))"
    },
    {
      "name": "left_right_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed difference between left-side segments (2,5) and right-side segments (3,6) to encode horizontal balance.",
      "value_range": [-2, 2],
      "feature_family": "symmetry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Signed projection useful as a near-linear discriminator between mirror-like digit shapes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#2 + attribute#5) - (attribute#3 + attribute#6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "middle_bar_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator emphasizing the central horizontal segment (attribute#4), weighted relative to total activity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights middle-bar presence which is a key linear separator across several digits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#4 / (1.0 + attribute#1 + attribute#2 + attribute#3 + attribute#5 + attribute#6 + attribute#7)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vertical_bars_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of the four vertical-side segments (2,3,5,6) capturing digit verticality.",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "weighted_sum",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearly separates digits dominated by vertical strokes from rounded shapes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#2 + attribute#3 + attribute#5 + attribute#6"
    },
    {
      "name": "horizontal_bars_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of the three horizontal segments (1,4,7) capturing digit horizontality.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "weighted_sum",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Useful linear axis distinguishing digits like 1 (few horizontals) from 2,3,5,8.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#1 + attribute#4 + attribute#7"
    },
    {
      "name": "vertical_minus_horizontal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized signed contrast between vertical and horizontal segment activity.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth bounded contrast that gives the SVM a meaningful real-valued projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((attribute#2 + attribute#3 + attribute#5 + attribute#6) / 4.0) - ((attribute#1 + attribute#4 + attribute#7) / 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "upper_loop_pattern",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite indicator approximating a closed upper-loop pattern (top, upper-left, upper-right, middle all lit).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "pattern_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a near-binary geometric feature that linearly aids margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.minimum(np.minimum(attribute#1, attribute#2), np.minimum(attribute#3, attribute#4))"
    },
    {
      "name": "lower_loop_pattern",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite indicator approximating a closed lower-loop pattern (middle, lower-left, lower-right, bottom all lit).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "pattern_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Geometric pattern useful as a linear feature for digits with closed lower loops.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.minimum(np.minimum(attribute#4, attribute#5), np.minimum(attribute#6, attribute#7))"
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_density_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of perimeter-edge segment density, computed as weighted emphasis on outer segments (1,2,3,5,6,7) over the central bar.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized score capturing perimeter-vs-center emphasis, useful as a linear SVM axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#1 + attribute#2 + attribute#3 + attribute#5 + attribute#6 + attribute#7) / 6.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "shape_compactness_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic compactness score: high when many segments are lit AND symmetry between top and bottom is preserved, indicating a compact filled glyph.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite smooth judgment that complements raw counts with shape-quality information for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((attribute#1 + attribute#2 + attribute#3 + attribute#4 + attribute#5 + attribute#6 + attribute#7) / 7.0) * (1.0 - np.abs((attribute#1 + attribute#2 + attribute#3) - (attribute#5 + attribute#6 + attribute#7)) / 3.0)"
    }
  ]
}
